title: Capital Adequacy Statement — Size Reduction on Large Class H Preferred Stock Redemptions, Member Equities & Patronage
content:
The redemption size reduction protects the association's capital from large Member Equities & Patronage Class H Preferred Stock redemptions: a holding that carried 500000 or more at the start of the current quarter has 5 points taken off; a holding that carried 100000 or more but below 500000 has 2 points taken off; a smaller holding has none taken off.

## Statement

| Shares carried at the start of the current quarter | Points taken off |
|---|---|
| 500000 or more | 5 |
| 100000 or more but below 500000 | 2 |
| Below 100000 | None |

The points are percentage points taken off the share of the redemption allowance base the quarter allows for redemption on the holding, before that share is applied to the base.

**Shares carried at the start of the current quarter** are the holding's present shares (its purchases plus its reinvested dividends less its retirements) less its latest reinvested dividend and its latest purchase when either is dated inside the quarter, plus its latest retirement when that is dated inside the quarter. The current quarter runs from 1 July 2026 to 30 September 2026; the latest entry of a kind is the one with the latest effective date on the holding.

## Edges (hypothetical holdings)

| Start-of-quarter shares | Points taken off |
|---|---|
| 99,999.99 | None |
| 100,000.00 | 2 |
| 499,999.99 | 2 |
| 500,000.00 | 5 |

A holding with present shares of 101,000.00 whose latest purchase, of 2,000.00, is dated 8 July 2026, with its latest reinvested dividend and latest retirement both dated before 1 July 2026, carried 99,000.00 at the start of the quarter and has none taken off.
